fields.meta_description: Build a referral form for patients or new hires. Emergent sends each referral to the right desk and keeps every one in a database you own.
fields.h1: Build a Referral Form That Routes and Tracks Every Referral
fields.hero_description: Describe who sends you referrals and who acts on them. Emergent builds the referral form, sorts urgent cases first and tells the sender what happened.
fields.features_heading: What a Referral Form Should Do After Submit
fields.features_subheading: A faxed referral PDF waits in a tray until someone finds it. These six pieces put each referral in front of the person who acts on it.
fields.feature_1:
Sorting by urgency or service

Ask the sender to mark each referral routine or urgent, or to choose a service. Urgent ones move ahead of the line with a booking deadline, and the rest wait in order of arrival.
fields.feature_2:
Notes and files required at submit

Require the documents the receiving side needs before the form submits: visit notes and labs for a specialist, a resume for a hiring manager. Nobody calls back for a missing page.
fields.feature_3:
Duplicate checks against past entries

Check each new name against earlier referrals and applicants. A candidate who applied four months ago gets flagged before two employees claim one bonus or a recruiter calls twice.
fields.feature_4:
Updates back to whoever referred

Email the referring office or employee when the status changes. They learn that the visit is booked or that the new hire has started, without phoning your front desk to ask.
fields.feature_5:
Referral codes with credits tracked

Give each customer a personal code to share. When a friend books and pays, the form records who sent them and adds a credit to both accounts. Nobody keeps a tally by hand.
fields.feature_6:
Your code in your GitHub repo

Export the full codebase to GitHub when the referral form grows into a patient portal or a partner program. Your developers host it on their own servers and keep extending it there.
fields.why_title: Why Build Referral Forms With Emergent?
fields.why_description: Whoever sends you a referral wants to know it landed. A form that routes it on arrival and reports back earns you the next one.

fields.tab_content_1:
Urgent referrals land at the top of the list

Harbor Heart Cardiology takes referrals from 14 primary care practices through one form. The referring office attaches visit notes and an ECG and marks the referral urgent or routine. Urgent ones go to the top of the scheduler's queue, to be booked within 2 business days, and the referring office is emailed the date.
fields.tab_content_2:
A referral with nothing tried goes back

Maplewood Middle School's support team meets every Thursday. Teachers refer a student by naming the concern and the supports tried so far, like a front-row seat or a daily check-in. A referral with none listed goes back to the teacher with the strategy list attached. The rest go on Thursday's agenda.
fields.tab_content_3:
Kestrel pays its $1,000 bonus at day 90

Kestrel Freight hires most drivers through people already on the road. An employee refers a friend with a resume and CDL class, and the form flags anyone who applied in the last 6 months. Once the new driver reaches 90 days, HR gets a Slack message to approve the $1,000 bonus for the referrer.
fields.tab_content_4:
21 of 38 referred friends have booked

Brightside Home Cleaning grows by word of mouth. Each customer gets a personal code, and when a referred friend's first clean is done, both get $50 off their next visit. This quarter the owner's dashboard shows 38 referrals, 21 booked and $2,100 in credits issued. The top referrer, Meg Torres, has sent 4 friends.

fields.howto_title: How to Create a Referral Form
fields.howto_description: Settle who sends referrals, who receives them and what counts as complete before you open the builder.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 Decide which referral you are taking
fields.howto_step_2_title: 02 List what the receiving side needs
fields.howto_step_4_title: 04 Plan the update the sender gets
fields.howto_step_1_des: A clinic receives patients from other doctors. A school receives concerns from its teachers, and a business receives names from employees or customers. Each flow needs its own fields and its own reviewer. Build one form per flow instead of one form that asks everything.
fields.howto_step_2_des: List the fields the receiving side needs to act without a phone call. A specialist wants the reason for referral, the insurance plan and recent notes. A hiring manager wants the role and a resume. Mark each field required or optional before you write the questions.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Write down who works each queue and how quickly. An urgent patient might need a visit within one business day, while routine ones wait in order. Name a backup for every queue, since a referral sitting in one inbox during a vacation goes cold.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Plan what the person who referred hears, and when. A doctor's office wants the visit date. An employee wants to know the candidate was hired and when the bonus pays out. Write those messages now, and they go out as soon as a status changes.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Paste your fields, routing rules and messages into one prompt. Emergent builds the referral form with a database table behind it and a dashboard for whoever works the queue. Change a field or a rule later by asking for it in plain English.
fields.howto_step_6_des: Connect email for updates to referrers and Slack for your own team's alerts. Hiring teams can connect their applicant tracking system through its API. Clinics can send each booked visit to their scheduling software the same way, without anyone copying it over.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Run one referral through end to end
fields.howto_step_7_des: Submit a test referral marked urgent, with a file attached, before sharing the link. Check that it reached the right queue and that the file opens. Confirm the sender's update arrived, then submit a routine one and watch it wait its turn.

plan.angle: The live top 10 is split. Clinics and template sites (Carepatron, Formstack, Warehouse Medical, a county health department's Jotform) post patient referral PDFs and blank forms, Pinterest serves printable blanks, and Jotform ranks a customer referral program template. People Also Ask adds teacher referrals and how to give someone a referral. Every result stops at the blank page. This page covers the four referrals searchers mean (a doctor sending a patient to a specialist, a teacher flagging a student, an employee recommending a hire, a customer sending a friend) and shows what happens after submit: urgent referrals sorted to the top, referrals returned when no support was tried yet, bonuses paid on day 90, and credits tracked per referral.
